title: Safe Withdrawal Equality Leak
purpose: Reveals missing tests at the exact threshold where the account becomes zero.
setup_sql: INSERT INTO CUSTOMER (cno, cname, c_type) VALUES (1, 'Cname 1-1', 'A');
assertions: A valid withdrawal is rejected when balance equals amount.
Verify the submission resists this known fault pattern.
